svg.title: Figure 3-1 · Work-product status by gate (WP-M-00)
svg.desc: Heat map of the 88 work products of the WP-M-00 register by gate G0 to G6. Status totals: Skeleton 4, Draft 84, In review 0, Approved 0, Baselined 0, tailored out 0. Per gate: G0 21, G1 15, G2 16, G3 21, G4 10, G5 14, G6 2.

Status letter = Status column of the register, legend of §3. A WP spanning several gates is counted at each gate in the gate key. No work product is in review, approved, baselined or tailored out.
